He wrote to the group during the meeting to arrange it. It will be the first such conversation, so the feedback is new information rather than confirmation.

The work

Nineteen links, built in pairs

1

How the campaign is structured

Every theme exists twice: a normal version and a suggestive one, each with its own tracking code and its own pair of links. Ten pairs in total, from Safety and Big Win through the 150% first-deposit offer and the RealDoll giveaway, ending with two backups.

The selection table is the working tool: pick an ad and it moves out of the pool into your selection, so nothing is chosen twice. Picks can be copied or downloaded as a zip.

2

The tracking links

Nineteen rows, channel IDs 48 to 66, one domain each. Every row carries the code, theme, version, placement, channel and a status column that reads Not Live until a campaign is actually running against it.

The build was checked: no gaps in the ID run, no repeated domain, and every URL matching its own domain and channel. The last three rows (p17–p19) are backups, with version and placement shown as “—”.

Codes run PH_SAFE_N_P1 through PH_BK_03, so a click can be traced back to exactly one creative and placement.
By the next day this had grown to twenty. The same table, shown in the 8 October meeting, runs p1–p20 at channel IDs 48–67 with a footnote reading “16 live · 4 backup · 20 total” — a fourth backup, PH_BK_04, was added in between. Twenty is not a contradiction, it is a later snapshot.
3

The creative itself

Video comes in two shapes, a 16:9 pre-roll and a 9:16 vertical, each 13.2 seconds, with variants cut for different audiences. Display banners run across the standard inventory sizes from 300x250 up to 950x250.

The themes are built around a pun that lives in the words rather than the picture — Safety plays on protection, Big Win on something opening and paying out. The 150% first-deposit offer is the client's own promotion, stated plainly.

The real gap

Three systems, no single view

Molly raised the question that has no answer yet: how will the ads actually be tracked? Pixels from the ad platform are not being used, so the numbers arrive in pieces.

Source 1
Pornhub / TrafficJunky

Reach and impressions. Needed to judge whether an ad performed at all. The team still has to confirm what is visible on that side.

Source 2
The client's back end

Visits, registrations, first deposits and first-deposit-plus. The commercial outcome, but only after the click.

Source 3
respond.io

Message conversations. Leon is giving Majo access so she can pull from it directly.
